verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਗੋ ਬੰਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਖਾਇ ਦੁਹੇ ਗੋਰਸ ਦੈ ਗੋਰਸ ਅਉਟਾਏ ਦਧਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau go ba(n)s tiran khai dhuhe goras dhai goras aauTaae dhadh maakhan pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: As a cow grazes on grass and hay yields milk which when heated, cooled and set to coagulate as curd, butter is obtained;

verses.gurmukhi: ਊਖ ਮੈ ਪਿਊਖ ਤਨ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੇ ਪਿਰਾਏ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਅਉਟਾਏ ਖੰਡ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: uookh mai piuookh tan kha(n)dd kha(n)dd ke piraae ras ke aauTaae kha(n)dd misaree miThaas hai ||

en.bdb: Sugarcane is sweet. It is put through a crusher to obtain its juice that is heated and converted into jaggery cakes and sugar crystals;

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਕੈ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਢਾਕ ਅਉ ਪਲਾਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh kai banaasapatee ddaak aau palaas jaise cha(n)dhan subaas hai ||

en.bdb: As a sandalwood tree infuses its fragrance in the vegetation that grows around it;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੯॥
verses.translit_en: saadh sa(n)g milat sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree hot gurmat paraupakaar ke nivaas hai ||129||

en.bdb: So does a worldly person become a humble servant of God in the company of saintly persons. By virtue of the teachings and initiation of Guru, he is blessed with the traits of doing good to all and sundry. (129)
